title: Table 2.3a Car parking provisions (visitor car parking bays per dwelling)
notes: Reference table for the visitor row of Table 2.3a. Rule C2.3.5 takes its threshold from table-2.3a-visitor-bays, whose rows give the bay count as an expression (ratio x total number of dwellings, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 up), because a lookup here returns the ratio, not the bay count. No 0-4 dwelling exemption in this chapter.
